title: BTC-ETH monthly equal-weight rebalancing premium
thesis: Resetting a fixed unlevered BTC and ETH spot portfolio to equal market value at each UTC month boundary improves fee-adjusted total return and Calmar versus the identical initially equal-value BTC-ETH holdings allowed to drift, with non-worse drawdown and broad annual support in both Design and historical Validation.
mechanism: Monthly equal-weight rebalancing sells part of the relative outperformer and buys the relative underperformer. The mechanism can monetize relative variance only when leadership reverses broadly enough to overcome two-asset execution costs; persistent leadership must make the hypothesis fail.
economic_rationale: The identical two-asset comparator isolates rebalancing from simple ETH inclusion, market direction and initial asset weights. The mechanism is useful only if incremental marked and terminal-liquidation return, drawdown, Calmar, annual breadth and concentration all pass under normal and doubled friction; weight control alone has no candidate value.
